name: Session Trigger: On System Startup
purpose: Trigger attached to layouts based on the Session table: on system startup it calls Ensure There is Session Record, which creates a session record for the connection when none exists.
open_question: Runs with full access privileges (runFullAccess=True). The session table logic is in script 45, outside this batch. Web Direct opens one connection per browser tab, hence a session record per connection (header comment).

name: Session On Last Window Close
purpose: Trigger that runs when the last window closes: calls Clean up Session Records to remove session records for the closing connection.
open_question: Runs with full access privileges (runFullAccess=True). The cleanup logic is in script 44, outside this batch.
